notes: v6.3 - NEW: SETUP.bat, the one-click one-time setup. The v6.2.x sign-in fixes worked, but every customer still had to fight the same setup by hand: install yt-dlp and ffmpeg, make the folders, export a cookies.txt. Now the zip carries SETUP.bat next to INSTALL.bat: run it once and it installs any missing tool via winget (or prints the exact manual link if winget itself is missing), creates your NaloxAura folders, opens the free 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' store page and YouTube for the three-step export, picks the exported file up from your Downloads folder by itself, and verifies the sign-in before printing its summary. It never deletes anything and needs no admin rights. The panel meets it halfway: if the cookies.txt it prepared exists and you have never chosen a sign-in method, Settings > YouTube sign-in starts already on with that file. Everything else is exactly v6.2.2. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
